{
  "name": "clawd",
  "version": "1.0.0",
  "description": "A pixel pet in the band above the prompt: Clawd (the Claude Code crab) or any pet you define. Reacts to what Claude is doing; any mod can drive it with $.clawd and hand it band rows; any program can drop a signal file. 60 Hz, real pixels where the terminal draws images, interactive on the desktop app",
  "author": {
    "name": "Shiran Yu",
    "url": "https://github.com/shiran-yu"
  },
  "homepage": "https://github.com/shiran-yu/cc-clawd",
  "repository": "https://github.com/shiran-yu/cc-clawd",
  "license": "MIT",
  "keywords": [
    "mod",
    "pet",
    "mascot",
    "pixel",
    "animation",
    "clawd"
  ],
  "types": "./types/index.d.ts",
  "userConfig": {
    "pet": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Pet",
      "description": "Which pet lives in the band: clawd, slime, or the id of a pack in ~/.config/clawd/pets/ or one another plugin registered (/clawd pets lists them)",
      "default": "clawd"
    },
    "renderer": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Renderer",
      "description": "auto: real pixels on terminals that draw images (kitty, Ghostty), character pixels on others, the interactive client on the desktop app; raster: character pixels; client: follows the pointer and reacts to clicks; image: real pixels; text: still frames",
      "options": [
        "auto",
        "raster",
        "client",
        "image",
        "text"
      ],
      "default": "auto"
    },
    "fps": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Frame rate",
      "description": "Frames computed per second; a frame is sent only when it changed",
      "options": [
        "30",
        "60",
        "120"
      ],
      "default": "60"
    }
  }
}
